content:
Here is the research on the exact capabilities of the top kid-safe phones (Gabb Phone, Pinwheel, and Bark Phone), focusing strictly on exact features, third-party/browser blocking, and notification data based on official Tier A/B documentation.

### 1. Gabb Phone (e.g., Gabb Phone 4 / 4 Pro)
**Core Capabilities & Strict Features:**
*   **Approved Contacts & Calls:** Parents manage a safelist via the parent app. "Gabb Guard" automatically blocks suspected spam. On heavily restricted settings, unknown numbers cannot reach the child.
*   **GPS Tracking:** Active GPS via the "MyGabb" app. Features include real-time tracking, "Safe Zones" (geofencing alerts), and a "Find My Phone" ping.
*   **SOS Capabilities:** The SOS functionality primarily triggers an alert to designated emergency contacts (parents), though standard emergency numbers like 911 can be dialed.
*   **Browser & 3rd-Party Blocking:** There is **no web browser and no open App Store**. The OS is locked down at the system level. Third-party apps (available more broadly on the "Pro" models) go through a strict internal vetting process for safety/privacy before they are allowed on the Gabb ecosystem.
*   **Notification Data:** Gabb Messenger uses "smart filtering" to scan for explicit images, links, or harmful language. It notifies parents via the Gabb Messenger for Parents app if issues are detected, and will automatically drop video calls if nudity is detected.

### 2. Pinwheel
**Core Capabilities & Strict Features:**
*   **Approved Contacts & Calls:** Enforces a strict "Contact Safelist." Only explicitly approved contacts can text or call. Unknown numbers are rejected or ignored by the system.
*   **GPS Tracking:** Continuous GPS location and location history tracking viewed through the Caregiver Portal.
*   **SOS Capabilities:** Parents can designate specific "Emergency Contacts" which bypass all downtime rules or schedules, ensuring the child can always reach them. 911 is functional.
*   **Browser & 3rd-Party Blocking:** Pinwheel strictly **modifies the Android OS to remove the internet browser completely**. It blocks third-party app installations by replacing the standard app store with a curated "App Library" of therapist-vetted apps that parents must remotely approve and push to the device.
*   **Notification Data:** The Caregiver Portal allows parents to view all text message history and call logs remotely, **even if the child deletes the message on the device**.

### 3. Bark Phone (Samsung A-series hardware)
**Core Capabilities & Strict Features:**
*   **Approved Contacts & Calls:** Full contact approval system. Calls from unapproved numbers are sent straight to voicemail, and texts from unknown numbers are hidden from the child.
*   **GPS Tracking:** Includes real-time location mapping, "Favorite locations" (geofencing for home/school), and manual "Check-in" requests.
*   **SOS Capabilities:** No dedicated proprietary SOS button, but designated "Emergency Contacts" remain reachable even when the phone is manually locked or on "pause." Supports 911.
*   **Browser & 3rd-Party Blocking:** Highly customizable, **tamper-proof OS**. Parents can entirely toggle the web browser off (which hides dedicated browser apps like Chrome). The standard Google Play Store is disabled by default. The phone actively blocks workarounds like the installation of VPNs or unauthorized configuration profiles.
*   **Notification Data:** Bark relies on **AI-powered alert data**. Rather than requiring parents to read every text, the system scans texts, images, emails, and 30+ installed apps. It generates alerts only when it detects risks (cyberbullying, drug use, sexual content, depression). Parents can also configure the device so that text messages are **undeletable** by the child.

**Note on "Strict Feature Count":** 
Because these devices operate as managed software platforms rather than static hardware, providing a single absolute integer for a "feature count" is inaccurate. The feature set scales based on the subscription tier and model (e.g., Bark's Starter vs. Advanced plans toggle browser/app permissions; Gabb Phone 4 is heavily restricted while Gabb Phone 4 Pro allows vetted third-party apps). However, the absolute core features shared by all three include: GPS Tracking, Contact Safelists, App Vetting/Blocking, and Remote Parent Dashboards.
